migration_reprocessing: Rebuild canonical insight slices from authoritative provider rereads where stored attribution/dimensions lost; cannot repair lost semantics by rename. Freeze old rows legacy_untrusted, reconcile totals without adding old/new. Forward migration + checkpoint, no DROP of ledger.
null_policy: Preserve missing/withheld/notrequested as NULL with reason; provider literal zero is0; empty complete response does not supply unreturned metric values. Ratios undefined ->NULL. Numeric strings parse Decimal, no binary float money.

async.completion: async_status Job Completed AND async_percent_completion100 then fully paginated results and durable acknowledgement
async.job_identity: query_hash + run_ref; provider report_run_id backend-only temporary
async.timeouts: keep pending/failed, no fabricated empty result

report_query.daily: time_increment=1; time_ranges forbidden for daily contract because it overrides increment; date_start=date_stop expected per row.
report_query.initial_recipe_authority: VOLC explicit reporting choice using documented params; not provider default and not AdSet attribution approval; validate exact query availability before deployment.
report_query.mode_exclusivity: Only one mode; snapshot setting at query time, hash into report definition; unified may ignore account flag, never send contradictory semantics.

retention.authority: Proposed VOLC policy; privacy/security owner must approve before storage production
retention.deletion: Authorized scoped purge after hold/retention checks; preserve nonidentifying audit hashes as legally approved; no automatic provider deletion.

schema_authority.new_entities: Logical contract identifiers, not claims that tables/columns already exist. Executor maps to existing meta tables and authorized forward migration without parallel cofre.

security.browser: Allowlisted projected refs/names/metrics/status/presence/freshness; no providerIDs, rawtargetingIDs, signedURLs, headers, user_data, token, rawproviderpayload.
security.rls: FORCE RLS where appropriate plus explicit grants; service role backend only and still enforce account/project scope in application; anon/auth no ledger direct reads/writes.
security.rpc: Least-privilege backend RPCs, fixed search_path, verified actor/account binding, no user_metadata authority; exposed security-definer functions require migration security adjudication.
security.views: Security-invoker or backend-only views; never assume view obeys RLS automatically.

sync_policy.checkpoints: Commit scoped cursor/reportprogress with acknowledged stage; all-page manifest before current promotion.
sync_policy.deletions: Tombstone only from authorized explicit remote status or complete scope with adjudicated absence meaning; loss of permission != deleted.
sync_policy.freshness_slo: VOLC proposal: operational inventory<=15min during active work; insights daily<=26h; freshness never provider guarantee.
sync_policy.hierarchy: Incremental field update where official edge supports; otherwise bounded fullscan, not fabricated updated_since parameter.
sync_policy.insights: Daily pull and restatement horizon = max selected attribution window + approved provider-lag buffer; initial30day lookback is VOLC policy, scheduled full-range correction as needed.
